mapper.select: select a.cm_micode,a.cm_codename from cmm0020 a,cmm0032 b where b.cm_syscd=#{CM_SYSCD} and b.cm_rsrccd=#{CM_RSRCCD} and a.cm_macode='LANGUAGE' and a.cm_micode=b.cm_langcd
select a.cm_rsrccd from cmm0036 a where a.cm_syscd=#{syscd} and a.cm_closedt is null and substr(a.cm_info,58,1)='1' and rownum=1
